extensions.description: Send fleet notifications to a Slack/Discord-compatible webhook. The first builtin extension, proving every DeviceKit contribution seam.
extensions.author: Juan Denis

extensions.description: Drive each device's real Chrome over the Chrome DevTools Protocol: navigate, read the DOM, evaluate JS, screenshot. Treat N devices as one browser farm with round-robin/random/LRU pools, FQL membership, busy-skip failover, and sticky sessions.
extensions.author: Juan Denis

extensions.description: A dashboard file manager for your devices: browse, upload, download, preview, rename, mkdir, and delete files over the agent's file API. Ships a real frontend page and a NodeDetail Files tab.
extensions.author: Juan Denis

extensions.description: Reads each capable device's notification feed on a schedule, records it (deduped, filtered, retained), forwards matches onto the notification bus, and unlocks the wait_for_notification automation step — the OTP/2FA primitive.
extensions.author: Juan Denis

extensions.description: Search the web from your fleet's real Chrome — not a key-based SERP API. Runs google/bing/duckduckgo queries through devicekit-browser's device pool: real-device fingerprint, residential IP, fleet rotation, no per-query cost. Owns no device code — the first extension to depend on another (plan 17).
extensions.author: Juan Denis

extensions.description: Drive ExpressVPN across your fleet: provision a user-supplied, hash-pinned APK, then connect/disconnect/status through version-keyed UI adapters that absorb the app's drift (a 13.x per-connect consent dialog is just an extra adapter step). Validates every exit country against an allowlist and verifies the real egress with a device-side geo-IP check — the app UI can't reveal a wrong-country connection. The worked example for plan 18's app-driver model (device_requirements + adapters + version policy).
extensions.author: Juan Denis

extensions.description: Drive devices through an Appium server: contributes an appium.run step type and appium.session_count fleet-query field.
extensions.author: Juan Denis
